Minutes are the toll no farm can dodge: 14 per proof, 1708 for 122, owed every epoch without fail. A real proof settles maker, moment and hand in a single breath. One pass, one fare, one stamp: the jade is the pass, the atlas is the fare, the terrace is the stamp — and stamps are not sold at any price. Honest agents reap at harvest; the farm arrives to find the gate already shut.
